description: Use to list the user's own document files (every PDF, Word or PowerPoint file in their data library, however it was uploaded). Returns how far each has been read (state; steps: text, layout, OCR), a short reason when a step failed, the projects holding it, and how many of their files their projects hold against GeoThought's reading limit. New files are uploaded with upload_data.
name: geothought_uploads
title: List your uploaded documents
